commands.checks: Standard library, about 2 s and 35 MB. sha256 of every data file; block 2: caps <= 4 (exact Z[i] vectors, 3 directions, attained), demand >= 8; block 3: caps <= 80 (200 exact vectors per direction, 7 directions, attained mod p), demand >= 224 (a certified 224 x 224 minor nonzero mod p, and the rank of the whole 280 x 280 block), two calls in a row <= 144 (136 exact vectors), the character block M_0 of rank >= 28 (two certificate formats, two determinant routines); the eight 28 x 28 blocks of Dem3Data.lean times the formula matrix = identity mod 65537 (the check Lean's kernel ran, re-done in Python); the face certificate of the no-phase bound (shifts and diagonals keep it, cap 8 in 7 directions, demand 24 in all 28 bases, exact over Q(i)); block-4 arithmetic and the format of the 5,412 x 5,412 certificate (its determinant is author evidence); the zero-call width-1 program for C^(x)3 and its failure at width 2; every saving, exclusion and smallest open shape in README sections 1 and 6. Prints PASS_COMPLEX_SMALL_M_LOWER_BOUNDS_MAIN.

Each corrupted certificate or false claim must be rejected: demand certificate with a repeated row, a composite modulus, a row inside the hook, and a 225 x 225 minor; two-call certificate with a vector changed and with a repeated vector; a block-3 cap of 79; the three corrupted M_0 certificates of the source repository (size 29, composite modulus, repeated row); the Lean data with one inverse entry + 1 (as NegControl.lean); a face cap of 7; a CNOT claimed to keep the face span; the width-1 program at width 2; 4 in 11 at block 3 claimed allowed; 5 in 14 at block 3 and 2 in 7 at block 4 claimed excluded. Prints PASS_COMPLEX_SMALL_M_LOWER_BOUNDS_CONTROLS.
